thread:
maria: Heads up — infra rolled nvidia-driver 550.12 -> 551.2 on staging earlier and we're seeing a clear small-batch tail latency regression for the runtime. p95 for tiny batches (1-4 tokens) jumped ~25% on gpt-medium.
aj: Ugh. Any traces or kernel-selection dumps yet?
maria: Quick profiling dump attached below (snip). Looks like the kernel selector is picking a different matmul path after the driver bump.
```
# before (550.12)
selected_kernel: matmul_128x128_shmem
latency: 0.62ms
# after (551.2)
selected_kernel: matmul_64x64_coop
latency: 1.18ms
autotune_entry: tile=64,split=2
```
maria: Also seeing more KV-cache evictions in the same window — prefetch hit-rate dropped ~7% which balloons latency on small batches.
dmitri: That smells like a scheduling/affinity change in the driver that altered occupancy or cooperative launch behavior. NVIDIA release notes mention some block-scheduler changes in 551.x recently.
sophia: Perf bot shows nightly-smallbatch failed 3/8 runs after the node images rolled. CI trend: clear step at the time the driver rolled. perf-bot: "nightly-smallbatch: regression detected (p95 +24%) — started at 2026-03-18T01:12Z" :eyes:
aj: Can you paste the Triton/autotune table differences? The autotune hits matter for small seqs.
maria: here's an extract from kernel_selector.log (both nodes run same Triton build):
```
[550.12] model: gpt-medium -> kernel_candidates: [matmul_128x128_shmem, matmul_64x64_coop]
    chosen: matmul_128x128_shmem (score 0.92)
[551.2] model: gpt-medium -> kernel_candidates: [matmul_128x128_shmem, matmul_64x64_coop]
    chosen: matmul_64x64_coop (score 0.81)
```
maria: raw microbench (single-matrix multiply) also shows matmul_64x64_coop slower on our HW by ~1.9x for MxN sizes typical to tiny batches.
dmitri: Two paths forward: (1) revert driver to 550.12 on canary until vendor fixes, or (2) force kernel selection override for affected models (temporary). We should also bisect if any internal change interacts (Torch/Triton minor bumps).
sophia: Quick repro command to run on a node:
```
# run smallbatch harness
python bench/smallbatch_stress.py --model gpt-medium --batches 2000 --seq 8 --profile kernel_selector
```
sophia: We should run that pinned to 550.12 and 551.2 to be 100% certain it's driver-only. Also try PyTorch 2.4 vs 2.5 just in case.
aj: If it's reproducible driver-only, open infra rollback ticket and pin canary nodes to 550.12. If it's driver+Triton combo, we need a mitigation in kernel selector.
maria: Temporary mitigation I tested: set env TRITON_KERNEL_HINT=matmul_128x128_shmem for the model, p95 dropped back close to baseline. Not ideal long-term but useful for rollout-blocker.
```
# example tweak
export TRITON_KERNEL_HINT=gpt-medium:matmul_128x128_shmem
```
dmitri: I'll open a vendor bug and include microbench numbers and kernel dumps. Opening internal ticket R-1209. assign @maria for repro artifacts, @aj for canary pin.
deploy-bot: Canary pin request queued — rolling nodes back to 550.12 in eu-west-1-canary within 30m if approved.
aj: Approve pin for canary. We won't revert prod yet, but freeze any further driver bumps.
maria: I'll run the harness across 3 different machine types (A100-40GB, A100-80GB mixed) and attach traces. Also will test the kernel override across our top 10 models.
sophia: Also verify KV prefetch thread counts — driver scheduling changes could change our prefetch thread behavior which in turn drops cache hit rates. Add prefetch counters to the smallbatch probe.
perf-bot: Added prefetch counters to next nightly run.
aj: Decision: pin canary -> run 24h smoke -> if green keep 550.12 cluster-wide until vendor responds OR we ship a selector fallback patch to force the faster matmul path for affected shapes. Action owners: dmitri (vendor bug + infra pin), maria (repro + override tests), aj (canary rollout gate).
maria: noted. pushing logs to the ticket now. :thumbsup:
